title: Database Transactions in Python, JavaScript and Java
title_es: Transacciones de base de datos en Python, JavaScript y Java
description: Runnable transaction examples: BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK in psycopg2, Node.js pg and JDBC, deadlock retry with backoff, advisory locks, and lock monitoring queries.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de transacciones: BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK en psycopg2, Node.js pg y JDBC, reintentos por deadlock con backoff, advisory locks y consultas de monitoreo de locks.
